question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "opposite."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"opposite" **means different, being in a position on the other side; facing. (दूसरी ओर की स्थिति में होना; का सामना करना )

 
 
• **Example**: *You'd never know they're sisters - they're completely **opposite**__ to each other in every way.*
 
 
 
• The sentence conveys that our instruction contrasted sharply with the knowledge, experiences, and convictions we had amassed. 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is ‘Option 2.'
 
• Correct sentence: 

I understood why these highly __trained__ professionals remained in the closet. I was one of __them__. We could not deny our __own__ experiences and senses. Yet our training was in many ways diametrically __**opposite**__ to the information, experiences and beliefs we had accumulated. So we remained ______ (5) ______. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Straight: **with no bends or curves; going in one direction only. (जिसमें न मोड़ हों न घुमाव; सीधा)
 
• **Perpendicular: **at an angle of 90 ° to something. (किसी वस्‍तु के 90 ° कोण पर; अभिलंब, लंबवत)
 
• **Diagonal: **(used about a straight line) at an angle; joining two opposite sides of something at an angle. (वर्ग के सम्‍मुख कोणों को मिलाने वाली सीधी रेखा या वर्ग के एक कोण से दूसरे कोण तक खींची गई सीधी रेखा; विकर्ण रेखा)
